{{Quote|I can clearly recall the day that Gnost-Dural and so many of my fellow Jedi boarded battle cruisers and left to defend the Minos Cluster. After the Jedi departed, true chaos broke out on Coruscant. The people had heard about wave after wave of crushing Imperial victories, and when the Jedi deployed, the tension overflowed.|Grand Master Satele Shan recalls the Coruscant riots|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
In [[3680 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''series of public demonstrations''' broke out on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in response to [[Politics/Legends|political]] infighting in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] invasion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Tensions began to mount in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] after the Empire made itself known through a series of conquests and massacres in the Outer Rim, but the situation became particularly volatile after the Republic's [[Tingel Arm campaign|biting loss]] of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] and the Empire's [[Minos Cluster Campaign|siege]] of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. While the Senate was mired in political gridlock over how to best respond to the assault, [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] moved forward with a plan to liberate the Minos worlds. Their departure, along with continued inaction from Republic leaders, sent the [[Coruscanti/Legends|people]] of Coruscant into panic, resulting in mass demonstrations consisting of political gatherings, anti-war rallies, and violent riots. The upheaval lasted for [[Standard day/Legends|days]] but came to a conclusion as stories of Jedi heroics in the embattled Minos Cluster began to return to Coruscant.

==Background==
{{Quote|Horrifying reports from the Outer Rim seemed to portend the utter destruction of the Republic. The rapid onset of galaxy-wide terror and panic was part of the Sith Emperor's meticulous calculations. His plan was flawless.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref>}}
[[File:IrateChagrianSenator-Timeline6.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Irate Republic Senators argue over defense strategy.]]
In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a revived [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] invaded the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], sparking the [[Great Galactic War]]. In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the war, the Republic suffered repeated losses across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the hands of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military's]] lightning-fast strikes and well-coordinated tactics. The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], taken aback by the blitz, was slow to react to the assault, allowing the Imperials to seize greater territory and strike fear into the hearts of Republic citizens. Although the efficiency of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] war machine prevented accurate reports from the front lines to spread quickly, news of the Empire's strength soon began to permeate throughout the Republic. Reports of the [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|destruction]] of a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] at the farthest reaches of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the [[Assault on the Aparo sector|defection]] of the [[Aparo sector/Legends|Aparo sector]], the [[Tingel Arm campaign|scattering]] of a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], the Sith [[Battle of Korriban|reclamation]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and the Empire's [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|massacre]] of [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van's]] defenders all served to mount tensions and fears&mdash;particularly in the heart of the Republic, which was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

This sense of panic&mdash;part of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] plan to destabilize the galaxy&mdash;was only amplified when the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic failed to compose a comprehensive defense strategy at an [[Senate emergency defense session|emergency congressional session]]. Republic leaders disagreed over how the Sith threat should be treated. Some advocated for patient and calculated responses, arguing that the Empire was no different from the many other minor upstart societies that had previously tried to challenge the Republic. Others, including the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], insisted that the Empire needed to be dealt with swiftly. However, even among these advocates of decisive action, there was disagreement. [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] who feared for the safety of their own worlds protested decisions that left their constituencies undefended against the Sith, resulting in messy deliberations and unnavigable [[Politics/Legends|political]] gridlock. When the negotiations collapsed, diplomatic allies withdrew military support, leaving most Republic [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] to fend for themselves<ref name="Timeline 6" /> and the people of the Republic in an even greater state of fear.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Riots and rallies==
{{Quote|Pandemonium ensued as some people rallied for war and others rallied for restraint. Still others used the opportunity to riot and break the law. It was disturbing to see the fear and desperation in the eyes of so many Republic citizens.|Master Satele Shan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
[[File:Fleeing_civilians.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The invasion of the Minos Cluster catalyzed the discord on Coruscant.]]
The Sith Empire, largely uninhibited by the Republic, launched a massive [[Minos Cluster Campaign|invasion]] of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] the same year.<ref name="JoMGD" /> In [[3680 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], refusing to sit idle as the Sith ravaged the Outer Rim, organized a fleet of [[Cruiser/Legends|battle cruisers]] to ferry their [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] to the Minos Cluster and defend its people. These developments proved to be a tipping point, and immediately after the Jedi's departure, chaos broke out on Coruscant. Hysteria gripped the populace as news continued to deliver stories of Imperial conquests that horrified many [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]]. Some organized mass political rallies in favor of the war effort, while others gathered to demand restraint in the fight against the Sith. Meanwhile, riots and looting wracked sections of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], all stemming from fears of the Empire's march toward the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

Jedi who remained on Coruscant were largely powerless to prevent the rioting and lamented seeing fear grip the people of the Republic. The chaos continued for days, until news of the Jedi efforts in the Minos Cluster began to filter back to Coruscant. Reports of their sacrifices and other acts of heroism inspired the people of the Republic, and the riots were extinguished shortly thereafter.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|This was the power of democracy at work, the validation of the principles we fight for, and the proof that, when cornered, the Republic can come together to make a courageous stand.|Master Shan|<ref name="JoMGD" />}}
Having been reassured by the efforts of the Jedi, the people of Coruscant refocused their energy from violence and upheaval to more patriotic endeavors. Immediately after the conclusion of the riots, Coruscanti people began registering for duty with the Republic Military to join the Jedi in battle. This boom in military registrations was accompanied by a change in political atmosphere; senators began to approach the issue of defense strategy less selfishly, and instead worked together to compose a comprehensive plan of action. It was after this point that the Republic began to achieve some of its first victories in the war&mdash;on the planet [[Eliad]] and other battlefields in the Minos Cluster, Jedi were joined by [[Republic soldier]]s, and together they fought off the Sith invaders; likewise, a reenergized Republic [[Navy/Legends|naval]] fleet broke the the crippling [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|blockade]] of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="JoMGD" />

Although overt violence in the capital had subsided, the people of Coruscant continued to suffer in the coming years. The onset of the war pushed the Republic into a severe [[Republic economic depression of the Great Wars|economic depression]] that continued for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]].<ref name="The Republic">{{Holonet|allegiances|galactic-republic|The Galactic Republic}}</ref> The economic woes of the Coruscanti turned into very real concerns over starvation and [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[3661 BBY]], when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian warrior clans]], having allied themselves with the Empire, [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockaded]] the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] severed the movement of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food supplies]] to the Core Worlds, resulting in heavy suffering and the return of [[Coruscant riots (3661 BBY)|mass riots]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]] of Coruscant. In the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|years after]] the Great Galactic War, Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] recalled her memories on Coruscant during the rioting of 3680 BBY. She added her experiences to a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|primary source]] volume on the war, noting her own sorrow over the desperation on Coruscant, as well as her optimistic appraisal of what the event revealed about the Republic's democracy.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant riots and demonstrations of 3,680 BBY were first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Legends|lore]] in [[2011]], with the release of [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], a short reference work included in Collectors Edition bundles of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The book was written by [[Robert Chestney]] under the personas of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Gnost-Dural]] and Satele Shan, the latter of whom recounts the demonstrations from an [[in-universe]], first person perspective.<ref name="JoMGD" />
